Golden Test Set

Functional Test Cases (from audit examples)

Input:
Simply add 42 (hex) and 10 (bin) and you will see the result is 68.

Expected Output:
Simply add 66 and 2 and you will see the result is 68.

---

Input:
There is no greater agony than bearing a untold story inside you.

Expected Output:
There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you.

---

Input:
Punctuation tests are ... kinda boring ,what do you think ?

Expected Output:
Punctuation tests are... kinda boring, what do you think?

Original Tricky Examples

---

Input:
1A (hex) files and 1010 (bin) bits were added.

Expected Output:
26 files and 10 bits were added.

---

Input:
I said ' hello world ' and smiled.

Expected Output:
I said 'hello world' and smiled.

---

Input:
This is a honest mistake.

Expected Output:
This is an honest mistake.

---

Input:
Ready, steady, go (up, 3)!

Expected Output:
READY, STEADY, GO!

---

Input:
He screamed !! and ran ... fast.

Expected Output:
He screamed!! and ran... fast.

Long Paragraph with Multiple Rules

---

Input:
This is a amazing moment (cap), one that we will never forget (up, 4) . We added 1F (hex) files and 1001 (bin) entries to the system ,which was ' completely broken ' before. The team shouted (low, 2) ,but then they said ' we did it ' !? What a success ,don't you think ?

Expected Output:
This is an amazing moment, ONE THAT WE WILL NEVER FORGET. We added 31 files and 9 entries to the system, which was 'completely broken' before. The team shouted, but then they said 'we did it'!? What a success, don't you think?
